description: Education calendar of madrasah (RA, MI, MTs, MA, MAK) in Jawa Tengah: 2026/2027 in full (45 dated events from the decree and its Lampiran, with its rules and the printed HK/HL/HE per month).
source: Kantor Wilayah Kementerian Agama Provinsi Jawa Tengah, Keputusan Nomor 1681 Tahun 2026 (raw PDF and SOURCE.txt in sources/kaldik-madrasah-jateng/, received from the user, brief R-06)
procedure: Transcribed by hand into tools/converters/kaldik-madrasah-jateng.py, which recomputes HK/HL/HE per month against the Lampiran, compares every holiday with libur-nasional and writes the JSON.
